Benjămin , m., indecl.
I. The young est son of the Hebrew patriarch Jacob, Aug. Civ. Dei, 17, 21; Sulp. Sev. Chron. 1, 12, 1 sqq.; Vulg. Gen. 35, 18 al.—
II. The Jewish tribe of Benjamin, Sulp. Sev Chron. 1, 29, 5.—Hence, Benjămītae , ārum, m., the Jews of the tribe of Benjamin, Sulp. Sev. Chron. 1, 29, 5.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
